summary: Room-alerts release fully tested. Backend: 43/43 pytest passing (9 new room-alerts tests + 33 legacy). Frontend: /stalls page renders ZoomableMap with − / + / Fit controls, admin dashboard shows 'APPROVED EXHIBITORS' with 'n pending approval · n total' sub-line, WhatsApp floating button + hero logo intact, 0 JS errors. Layout detection (OpenCV+tesseract) works end-to-end incl. re-detect from object storage. Organizer alerts are non-blocking; enquiry auto-reply sets ackSent=true.

test_details.upload_map_detection: POST /api/admin/stalls/upload-map with a plain 1x1 PNG → 200, data.url is /api/files/roar-expo/stall-maps/*.png (fetches 200 image/*), detection object has keys ok/boxes/rows/prefixes/ocrEngine (boxes=0, ok=true).
test_details.upload_map_synthetic_layout: Uploading a 800x600 PNG with 12 dark-bordered light rectangles yields detection.ok=true with >=6 boxes detected. ocrEngine='pytesseract' available.
test_details.detect_layout_object_storage: POST /api/admin/stalls/detect-layout reads the last uploaded map back from object storage via utils.storage.get_object and returns 200 with a fresh detection object — no 404/500.
test_details.apply_layout: POST /api/admin/stalls/apply-layout with 3 TAG-* stalls at gold + series creates stalls with mapX/mapY; GET /api/public/stall-directory returns them with coordinates; GET /api/public/stall-map returns the series entry. Re-apply is idempotent (200, updates only).
test_details.organizer_alerts_nonblocking: POST /api/visitors/register, multipart POST /api/exhibitors/register (with PNG logo), and POST /api/enquiries all succeed with RE-VIS-* / RE-STL-* codes; created docs have no emailError (organizer alert send never blocks the write). Exhibitor logoUrl persisted to /api/files/... and re-fetch is 200.
test_details.enquiry_auto_reply: Enquiry doc has ackSent=true and no ackError after ~2s wait (Gmail app-password delivery working).
test_details.frontend_stalls_page: /stalls renders 'Venue layout & stall bookings' heading, counters (0 stalls on the map / 0 available / 0 reserved / 0 booked), 'All categories' filter, ZoomableMap toolbar showing '100% + − Fit' controls + helper text 'Zoom in to read stall numbers | drag or scroll to move around | hover or tap a stall for details'. Clicking + and Fit works with 0 JS errors.
test_details.frontend_admin_dashboard: First stat card label = 'APPROVED EXHIBITORS' with sub-line '2 pending approval · 2 total'. Old label 'EXHIBITOR REGISTRATIONS' no longer used on that card.
test_details.regressions: Navbar right cluster: [Enquiry, Register as Visitor, Register as Exhibitor]. WhatsApp button data-testid='whatsapp-float-button' present with href https://wa.me/919284182675?text=... Hero logo intact. 0 console errors on home + /stalls + admin dashboard.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/admin.py is now ~920 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Split stall-map handlers (upload-map, detect-layout, apply-layout, map-series, generate-from-series) into a dedicated router file for maintainability.

detect_current_layout swallows all get_object exceptions as 404 'file is missing'. If the underlying storage backend errors for other reasons (auth, network) the admin will see a misleading 'upload it again' message; log the actual error and consider surfacing a 500 for non-NotFound failures.

layout_detect.detect_layout imports cv2/numpy lazily inside helpers; that's fine, but detection is CPU-bound and runs synchronously in asyncio.to_thread — for large plans with 100+ stalls this can hold a worker for several seconds. Consider a per-request timeout or offloading to a queue.

Consider Pydantic models for apply-layout / map-series payloads instead of raw dict Body — current 400s use string 'detail' returned as 'message' by the exception handler, but strong typing would eliminate a class of bugs and give clients better validation errors.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_ / test.ra.* prefixed visitor/exhibitor/enquiry rows and TAG-1..3 stalls, then cleaned them up in the same run (test_cleanup_ra + inline deletes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Room-alerts features (layout upload+detect+apply, non-blocking organizer alerts, enquiry auto-reply, admin approved/pending counts) covered in /app/backend/tests/test_room_alerts.py. cv2, numpy, tesseract binary and rapidocr-onnxruntime all installed and working. Frontend URL from /app/frontend/.env is https://code-fetch-43.preview.emergentagent.com (differs from the c9e4cfb8-...preview URL listed in the review request — env is source of truth). Error payloads still use 'message' not 'detail'.
